news.title: Alberta's decisive decision to stay in Canada gives Carney backing to take on Trump
news.summary: The overwhelming vote by Alberta to stay in Canada gives Mark Carney political capital to focus on remaking the country's economy, writes the BBC's Lyse Doucet.

news.title: 罗马尼亚新一届政府宣誓就职
news.summary: 当地时间10月20日，罗马尼亚总理尼古列斯库领导的新一届政府通过议会信任投票，随后在总统府宣誓就职。

news.title: 胡塞武装称过去24小时也门遭沙特空袭93次
news.summary: 当地时间10月20日，也门胡塞武装发言人叶海亚称，过去24小时内，沙特战机对也门焦夫省、塔伊兹省、萨达省、马里卜省、哈杰省、拉赫季省、阿姆兰省和伊卜省的民用目标发动93次空袭及导弹袭击。

news.title: 乌克兰问题会谈在挪威举行 美特使将赴俄转达相关内容
news.summary: 当地时间20日，美国总统特朗普的特使威特科夫和乌克兰总统泽连斯基在挪威奥斯陆举行会晤，参会者还包括来自挪威、芬兰等其他欧洲国家的领导人，特朗普女婿库什纳以视频方式参会。

news.title: 以军称打死哈马斯安全机构高级成员
news.summary: 当地时间20日晚，以色列国防军与以色列国家安全局(辛贝特)发表联合声明，称当天早些时候对加沙城地区发动精准空袭，打死了哈马斯安全机构高级成员亚辛。

news.title: 美官员：美总统特使将于21日与普京会面
news.summary: 当地时间10月20日，据美国官员透露，美国总统特使威特科夫将于21日与俄罗斯总统普京会面，特朗普女婿库什纳将以视频方式参与。

news.title: Zelensky says US intelligence sharing 'works now' after talks with Trump envoy in Oslo
news.summary: Ukraine had accused the US of withholding key intelligence - a claim rejected as "scandalous" by Washington.

news.title: Suspect arrested after historic town hall set alight - French media
news.summary: The spire of the clock tower at Limoges city hall dramatically collapsed as it was engulfed in flames on Saturday.

news.title: Trump and Zelensky appear at loggerheads despite Oslo optimism
news.summary: The Ukrainian leader's hug with Steve Witkoff in the Norwegian capital is unlikely to dispel misgivings about US policy towards his country, writes Paul Adams.

news.title: Trump sued over Canadian tariffs in latest legal challenge
news.summary: The lawsuit argues the White House exceeded its authority in imposing the latest tariffs on the country and caused "immediate harm to American businesses".

news.title: Cornell Jane Doe says embattled university head doubted her gang-rape allegation
news.summary: As a no-confidence vote looms, Cornell says the characterisation of the head's reaction is "incorrect".
